title: Camélia
subtitle: A colourless oval framed in intense pink. From the Bloom Collection.

stone.origin: Natural. GIA certified. No bowtie. Fancy intense pink diamond halo and split-shank pave. Set in 18K rose gold.

description: A colourless oval sits at the centre, cut cleanly enough to carry no shadow across its face, and framed in a halo of fancy intense pink diamonds that continues as pavé down the split shank. The pink does not compete with the white — it warms the air around it, so the centre reads brighter and cooler by contrast. Set in rose gold, the whole ring is built like the flower it is named for: colour opening around a clear, still centre. From the Bloom Collection.
